inputValues.value: SELECT ep_id, closed FROM enrollment_stage es1 WHERE id='#{epStageId}' AND stage_type_code IN (json_elments_to_text('#{stagesForUpdate}')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollment_stage es2 WHERE es1.ep_id=es2.ep_id AND es1.round_no=es2.round_no AND stage_type_code=’CHOICE_APPLICATION’ AND opening_time BETWEEN to_date('#{epStartDate}', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND now())
